question.text: If a Cat III AIF is structured as a Trust, the profits and gains from business or profession of the fund are taxed at:

explanation.text: The Logic: For a Trust-formed Category III AIF, the broad rule under Section 115UB(4) applies, and such income is taxed at the Maximum Marginal Rate (MMR), currently 30%. The Trap: Standard slab rates, zero (exempt) and 15% flat are not the prescribed treatment for the business/profession income of a Trust-formed Cat III AIF. Note: Capital gains and other income streams of a determinate trust may be treated separately under the concessional capital-gains rates discussed elsewhere in the chapter; this question is limited to the broad Section 115UB(4) rule.
